name: Web Story Auto-Publish

# Same fix as the blog workflow: the old file used `continue-on-error: true` on
# the generate step, so a failing run still showed a green tick while no story
# was produced. It now fails the job loudly and opens an issue when nothing was
# published.

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 15 * * 1,3,5'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: daily-webstory
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  generate-webstory:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'

      - name: Install sharp
        run: npm install --no-save sharp

      - name: Generate today's web story
        id: gen
        env:
          GROQ_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GROQ_API_KEY }}
          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}
          DEEPSEEK_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY }}
          INDEXNOW_KEY: ${{ secrets.INDEXNOW_KEY }}
          WORKFLOW_PAT: ${{ secrets.WORKFLOW_PAT }}
          SITE_API_FALLBACK: '1'
        run: node scripts/generate-webstory.mjs

      - name: Ping search engines
        if: success()
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          curl -s "https://www.google.com/ping?sitemap=https://aitoolsnova.com/sitemap.xml" || true
          curl -s "https://www.bing.com/ping?sitemap=https://aitoolsnova.com/sitemap.xml" || true

      - name: Open issue if publishing failed
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const title = `🚨 Web Story auto-publish failed — ${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}`;
            const runUrl = `https://github.com/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`;
            const body = [
              'The scheduled Web Story did **not** publish. The run went red instead of silently staying green.',
              '',
              `- Run: ${runUrl}`,
              `- Commit: ${context.sha}`,
              '',
              'Most common cause: no AI provider is reachable (Groq / Gemini / DeepSeek and the site API fallback all failed).',
              '',
              'Fix (2 min): set at least one repository secret `GROQ_API_KEY` (free at https://console.groq.com/keys), `GEMINI_API_KEY` or `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, then Actions → Web Story Auto-Publish → Run workflow.',
            ].join('\n');
            const existing = await github.rest.issues.list({
              owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo,
              state: 'open', labels: ['publish-failure'], per_page: 5,
            });
            if (existing.data.length === 0) {
              await github.rest.issues.create({
                owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo,
                title, body, labels: ['publish-failure', 'automation'],
              });
            }
